# PR #103 — Cache fixture loads in the mock server

**Status:** Merged
**Labels:** `internal`, `performance`
**Author:** @eng-jlewandowska

---

## What changed

`load()` in `mock-api/server.py` re-read and re-parsed the fixture JSON on every
request. It now reads each file once and caches the parsed result in a
module-level dict.

## Why

The search endpoint was reading `trips.json` from disk on every call. Harmless at
our fixture sizes, but it made the request timings noisy when profiling the
booking flow.

## Diff summary

```
mock-api/server.py
- def load(name): opens and parses on every call
+ def load(name): parses once, returns the cached object
```

## Behaviour change

None. Same responses, same status codes, same error messages. Internal only.
